name: @usrp/feature-compliance
description: Citizen erasure requests and self-withdrawal (both real). The DPO queue has NO edge operation yet.
//dependencies: @atlaskit/textarea is the ONE unpinned range left in this repository, deliberately. No other package here consumes it, so there is no in-repo evidence for the correct major and inventing a plausible one is how a dependency tree acquires a version nobody chose. It needs an explicit decision against the ADS release the rest of these pins came from. Every other former '*' in this file was pinned to the range already used elsewhere in the repo. @usrp/api-client supplies the ONE contract-asserted transport: the citizen half of Law N 058/2021 is reachable today, the DPO half is not.
//peerDependencies: React, ReactDOM and the router are PEERS, not dependencies. The host app owns the single instance; a second React in the graph throws 'invalid hook call' and resolves context to the wrong provider. The devDependency copies exist only so this slice typechecks and tests standalone.
